title: Board Games & MarioKart w/ 5C Gaming
seo_title: Board Games & MarioKart Night at Gailey's in Springfield
description: Game night at Gailey's Breakfast Cafe, teaming up with 5C Gaming, with MarioKart on the Switch (race friends and win prizes) and a large selection of board games. You can come solo or bring a group, and guests with a student or teacher ID get 20% off their tab. It runs every Thursday starting at 5 PM at 220 E Walnut St in Springfield, MO, with this listing for December 3, 2026 (time TBD).
address: 220 E Walnut St,Springfield, Missouri, Springfield, MO
